name: Stock Entry Detail-custom_sales_price
label: Sales Price
description: Unit selling price per STOCK UoM. Auto-filled from the source Material Request line or the default selling Item Price; can be overridden. Not shown as a grid column by default: custom columns evict standard ones (Source/Target Warehouse on transfers). Add it via the grid's column settings if wanted.

name: Material Request-custom_user
label: User
description: User who created this document (shown as the first column on the list view).

name: Stock Entry-custom_user
label: User
description: User who created this document (shown as the first column on the list view).

name: Stock Entry Detail-custom_total_amount_sales_price
label: Total Amount (Sales Price)
description: Sales Price x stock qty for this row (computed). Not shown as a grid column by default: custom columns evict standard ones (Source/Target Warehouse on transfers). Add it via the grid's column settings if wanted.

name: Stock Entry-custom_total_qty
label: Total Qty
description: Sum of the Qty column across all item rows (computed).

name: Stock Entry-custom_total_sales_amount
label: Document Total (Sales Price)
description: Sum of Total Amount (Sales Price) across all item rows (computed).

name: Customer-custom_visit_day
label: Visit Day
description: Weekday (Monday–Sunday) denormalized from the active Journey Plan on submit. Used by the mobile app to resolve today's route.

name: Customer-custom_journey_plan
label: Journey Plan
description: Active Journey Plan covering this customer. Auto-set on Journey Plan submit/cancel.

name: Sales Invoice-custom_return_reason
label: Return Reason
options:
Expiry
Damaged
Slow Moving
Not Paying
Others
description: Reason for this credit note / return. 'Expiry' halves item rates and routes goods to the Reparking Warehouse.

name: Sales Invoice-custom_return_narration
label: Return Narration
description: Provide details when Return Reason is 'Others'.

name: Sales Person-custom_mapped_warehouse
label: Mapped Warehouse
description: Van/stock warehouse this sales person operates from (destination for van requests). Read by the Sales Pro mobile app on login.

name: Sales Person-custom_serving_warehouse
label: Serving Warehouse
description: Source warehouse that serves this sales person (van requests are transferred from here). Read by the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Sales Person-custom_cash_account
label: Cash Account
description: Cash/collection account used for this sales person's van sales. Read by the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Sales Person-custom_route_names
label: Route Names
description: Route(s) assigned to this sales person. Read by the Sales Pro mobile app on login.

name: Sales Person-custom_sap_sales_employee_code
label: SAP Sales Employee Code
description: SAP SalesEmployeeCode for this rep. It is what ties SAP's sales employee to THIS record, so customers assigned to them in SAP land on this route instead of on a second Sales Person created from SAP's spelling of the name. Filled in automatically when the names match; set it by hand when they do not.

name: Material Request-custom_van_request
label: Van Request
description: Marks this Material Request as a van stock request raised from the Sales Pro mobile app. Placed after Set Target Warehouse so the transfer warehouse fields keep their position.

name: Material Request-custom_van_return
label: Van Return
description: Marks this Material Request as a van stock return raised from the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Material Request-custom_dales_order
label: Sales Order
description: Sales Order this van request relates to. Fieldname spelling ('dales') is kept to match the Sales Pro mobile app exactly.

name: Material Request-custom_total_qty
label: Total Qty
description: Total quantity across all lines. Sent/read by the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Material Request-custom_total_stock_value
label: Total Stock Value
description: Verified total selling value of the requested lines. Set by the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Material Request-custom_request_form
label: Request Form
description: Request form reference sent by the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Material Request-custom_narration
label: Narration
description: Notes entered on the van request/return in the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Material Request Item-custom_sales_price
label: Sales Price
description: Unit selling price per line. Sent/read by the Sales Pro mobile app. Not shown as a grid column by default: custom columns evict standard ones (Source/Target Warehouse on transfers). Add it via the grid's column settings if wanted.

name: Sales Order Item-custom_sales_price
label: Sales Price
description: Unit selling price per line. Sent/read by the Sales Pro mobile app. Not shown as a grid column by default: custom columns evict standard ones (Source/Target Warehouse on transfers). Add it via the grid's column settings if wanted.

name: Stock Entry-custom_sales_rep_confirmed
label: Sales Rep Confirmed
description: Set to 'Yes' by the Sales Pro mobile app once the rep confirms receipt of the transferred van stock. Editable after submit.

name: Item Group-custom_van_sell
label: Van Sell
description: When ticked, items in this group are loadable/sellable from the van. The Sales Pro mobile app restricts all item and stock loads to van-sell item groups.

name: Lead-custom_tin_number
label: TIN Number
description: Customer Tax Identification Number captured when creating a lead in the Sales Pro mobile app.

name: Sales Invoice-custom_efris_fdn
label: EFRIS FDN
description: URA EFRIS Fiscal Document Number. Read by the Sales Pro mobile app for the fiscal receipt.

name: Sales Invoice-custom_efris_verification_code
label: EFRIS Verification Code
description: URA EFRIS verification code. Read by the Sales Pro mobile app for the fiscal receipt.

name: Sales Invoice-custom_efris_qr_code
label: EFRIS QR Code
description: URA EFRIS QR code payload. Read by the Sales Pro mobile app for the fiscal receipt.

name: Work Order-custom_batch_number
label: Batch Number
description: Generated via the 'Generate Batch' button (BAT:NNN MFG:dd.MM.yyyy item). Auto-filled on the Manufacture Stock Entry's finished item.

name: Work Order-custom_mfg
label: MFG Date
description: Manufacturing date stamped when the batch is generated.

name: Work Order-custom_expiry_date
label: Expiry Date
description: Batch expiry = MFG date + Item shelf life (days).

name: Work Order-custom_batch_no
label: Batch No
description: Hidden mirror of Batch Number kept for print formats/scripts that reference custom_batch_no.

name: Batch-custom_batch_status
label: Batch Status
description: QC disposition of this batch. New batches start in Quarantine; Quality Inspection updates it on submit.

name: Quality Inspection-custom_batch_status
label: Batch Status
description: Disposition for the inspected batch. Copied onto the Batch when this Quality Inspection is submitted (or edited after submit).

name: Customer-custom_sap_cardcode
label: SAP CardCode
description: SAP Business Partner code — set by the customer sync; required to push transactions for this customer.

name: Stock Entry-custom_sap_docentry
label: SAP DocEntry
description: Set on Stock Entries auto-created from SAP Inventory Transfers (van stock pull). Unique so one SAP transfer can never be pulled twice.

name: Account-custom_sap_gl_account
label: SAP G/L Account
description: The matching G/L account code in SAP B1. Used whenever this account is posted to SAP — incoming payments, banking and expense journals. Leave empty to fall back to the ERPNext Account Number.

name: Sales Person-custom_customer_list
label: Customers
description: Customers assigned to this sales person, i.e. carrying them in the customer's Sales Team. This is the same assignment the Sales Pro app filters on, so a customer added here appears on the rep's phone.
